en.title: Your privacy choices
en.description: We use optional analytics to understand how this website is used and optional advertising tools to measure campaigns and support relevant advertising. You can accept or decline optional tools, manage each category, and change your choice using Privacy choices.

en.analyticsDescription: Helps us understand website use through Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity.
en.advertisingDescription: Supports campaign measurement and relevant advertising through Google Ads, Floodlight and MNTN.
en.gpc: Global Privacy Control is enabled in your browser. Analytics and advertising remain off.
en.dnt: Do Not Track is enabled in your browser. Analytics and advertising remain off.
en.storageUnavailable: Your browser could not save this choice. It applies to this page only.
en.saved: Your privacy choices have been saved.
en.savedSession: Your privacy choices apply to this page.

es.title: Tus opciones de privacidad
es.description: Usamos herramientas de análisis opcionales para entender cómo se utiliza este sitio web y herramientas publicitarias opcionales para medir campañas y apoyar publicidad relevante. Puedes aceptar o rechazar las herramientas opcionales, administrar cada categoría y cambiar tu elección mediante Opciones de privacidad.
